nodes.name: pgmq_read_order(q_orders_normalize, vt=60, qty=10)
nodes.notes: Pops up to 10 messages per tick with a 60s visibility timeout. The processor + envelope must complete inside 60s; otherwise the message reappears and read_ct increments.

parameters.query: SELECT msg_id, read_ct, enqueued_at, vt, message FROM public.pgmq_read_order('q_orders_normalize', 60, 10)

nodes.name: Invoke lib_retry_envelope
nodes.notes: RFC-002 lib_retry_envelope: classifies processor outcome, calls pgmq_delete_order on success, pgmq_set_vt_order on retryable, pgmq_archive_order + dlq_alerts INSERT on exhausted/non-retryable. processor_workflow_id field on the envelope routes to shopify_normalize_to_canonical (OdYCsotEru63kxN7).
